desc: Analyze the problem logic: model as permutation cycles, check reachability, compute union of paths to X.
Read N, X, arrays A, B, P, Q.
Identify cycles for P and Q.
Verify all red balls are in X's P-cycle and all blue balls are in X's Q-cycle. If not, print -1.

Compute the set of boxes $S_P$ required for red balls: the union of paths from each red-ball source to X in P-graph (excluding X). This is equivalent to the path from the red-ball source with the maximum distance to X.
Compute the set of boxes $S_Q$ required for blue balls: similarly for blue balls in Q-graph.
